Subject: Order form + MSA redlines — publicity / logo custody & evidence

Hi Erin / Maya,

Thanks for sending over the draft AO Order Form. Attaching our suggested MSA and Order Form redlines (Redwood-MSA-v3_redlines.pdf). The two items we want to resolve before signature are: (1) the publicity/confidentiality carveouts around customer case studies and press, and (2) logo custody / asset use evidence so we can safely include Atlas Ops in our customer list and press.

Quick summary of our asks:
- We can agree to a limited publicity carveout for product announcements and customer spotlights, but we need a short embargo window (we suggest 14 days) and a defined evidence package (signed release + screenshot of announcement or a PR link).
- Logo use: Redwood requests permission to use Atlas Ops logo in customer lists, website, and press kit assets. On logos, we prefer to restrict usage to a controlled set of assets (press kit files we provide/approve) and require a single approved vector file rather than allowing ad-hoc logo scraping.
- We propose an 'asset custody' clause in the Order Form: Atlas will deposit high-res logo files to a shared S3 folder (read-only for Redwood marketing) and provide a single point of contact for approvals.

Can you confirm Atlas' legal team's position on the embargo length and whether you can accept an evidence escrow approach for logos? If helpful, I can route a short set of redline snippets from our counsel.

Attachments: Redwood-MSA-v3_redlines.pdf (summary redlines), draft mutual action plan (inline)

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm major constraints (embargo days, publicity carveouts).
2) We swap one clean redline set (MSA+OrderForm) and agree an evidence packet definition.
3) Legal signs and Ops uploads approved logos to shared bucket.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call this week if that moves faster.

Best,
Ben

Appreciate the clear summary. We reviewed Redwood's redlines internally and attached our comments (Atlas-OrderForm_redline_0705.pdf). A few points from Atlas Legal:

- Publicity carveout: Atlas is willing to permit customer spotlights and press mentions but asks for a 30-day embargo in the contract (we flagged that in the redline).
- Case studies: We want a general right to approve written case studies (content control) and require a short review window (5 business days).
- Logo use: Atlas is fine with logo in customer lists and press kit, but we need color and clearspace constraints preserved. We cannot agree to an open deposit model where Redwood modifies assets. We propose: Atlas will provide one approved SVG and PNG set; Redwood must use the exact provided files and submit a usage notice by email when publishing.
- Evidence: we can provide an announcement link or PR release as evidence. For internal marketing materials (e.g., slides distributed externally), we require written approval per instance.

Attached are our annotated redlines and a short proposed publicity paragraph. If Redwood requires a logo escrow with retention rules, please outline the operational mechanics — that is not standard for us.

Erin

Ben / team —

Thanks for looping Legal in. Quick guidance and suggested contract language below. Overall position: we can accept a 30-day embargo as a commercial compromise, but we should tighten the evidence and logo-use language so Atlas cannot silently block broad marketing use after signature.

Proposed changes (high level):
1) Embargo window: accept "Embargo: up to 30 calendar days from date of execution" but include a hard exception for previously-public information and product launches that Redwood coordinates and where Atlas provides timely review. This prevents indefinite hold.

2) Evidence package: define a required "Marketing Release Packet" consisting of: (a) URL to public announcement or PR release, (b) signed marketing release (simple one-paragraph form), (c) one approved logo file set (SVG, PNG) and a screenshot if available. Contract should list these three items explicitly.

3) Logo custody / usage: insert Order Form clause: "Provider may use Customer's provided logo files solely in the formats supplied and only for the uses listed in Appendix A (website, press kit, and third-party event marketing). Provider shall send a notification email to customer-ops@atlas-ops.com at least 3 business days prior to first public use; customer shall not unreasonably withhold approval for uses consistent with Appendix A." This keeps Atlas' requirement for preserved colors/clearspace but prevents ad-hoc denial after signature.

4) Evidence escrow (operational): suggest a mutually readable S3 location or shared Drive with read-only access for Redwood marketing and write access limited to Atlas. Redwood will not modify customer-provided files. Include a retention policy: customer assets remain available for 24 months post-termination for marketing evidence.

5) Approval timing: for marketing materials that are not formal press releases (e.g., slide decks), require a 2-business-day notice and approval; for written case studies, require 5-business-day review window. If no response in that window, approval is deemed granted.

If you want, I can prepare exact redline snippets for insertion into the MSA and Order Form (short, ~3 sentences each). Recommended next step: Ben to send a one-page bullet compromise to Erin summarizing the five points above and ask Atlas Legal to accept in principle so we can exchange final redlines.

Kim
